title: Cynthia W NDE 2398
content: I had a tubule pregnancy that ruptured. I remember in the emergency room the nurse not wanting to 'take a crashing patient' up to surgery by herself. I remember seeing my blood pressure drop on the monitor. I came to up in the surgery room. Right before surgery, I was scared and crying. I told the doctor that I was afraid I wouldn't wake up. He said, 'You are very, very sick and need to go to sleep so I can help you.' I went to sleep but lost a lot of blood. I remember feeling as if I was lying down but I felt nothing under me. It was dark around me but I wasn't scared. I felt peace. No memories of worldly pains, emotionally or physically. There was like a door to the right side of my legs. Just beyond it, there was a male being. I didn't see him but I felt him and heard him. Not The way we hear though. I still heard him and I knew it was male because the voice was deep. He told me I had a choice to stay or go. All of a sudden, I felt this urgency. I said, 'No! Robert needs me!' I then felt like I jerked back into my body. When I came to one of the nurses came to me and asked me who Robert was. I told her he was my boyfriend. I asked her why. She got a funny look on her face and told me she and the doctors were very concerned about me because I was very, very sick, and suddenly out of the blue I yelled at the top of my lungs, 'No Robert needs me!' She said it startled them. I recovered from this surgery very quickly. My doctor was amazed at how fast I healed. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: September 29, 2002 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Surgery-relatedChildbirth ruptured tubal pregnancy Life threatening event, but not clinical death Ruptured tubule pregnancy, I crashed. How do you consider the content of your experience? Mixed Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal I knew with every fiber of my being that this was real. No one can convince me different. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? When I heard the voice. Were your thoughts speeded up? Neither Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening all at once Were your senses more vivid than usual? More so than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. It was dark, and I was able to see to the right without even turning my head. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I heard the deep voice not with my ears but somehow I heard him. I can't explain it. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Neither Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Uncertain Did you see any beings in your experience? Sensed their presence Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes A male was there I can't describe him but he told me I had a choice whether to stay or go. I don't know who it was. Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? Neither Did you see an unearthly light? No Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Unfamiliar, strange place What emotions did you feel during the experience? First peace then urgency to get back. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Relief or calmness Did you have a feeling of joy? Neither Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? Neither Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe Did scenes from your past come back to you? Neither Did scenes from the future come to you? Neither Did you come to a border or point of no return? A conscious decision to 'return' to life God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Moderate Christian Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Moderate Christian Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? Definite being, or voice clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see deceased or religious spirits? Sensed their presence Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Uncertain After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes Trying to explain how I heard the voice, not with my ears. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes I seem to sometimes know the answer to things that I never knew. Like someone asked if Angels were male or female. I said neither. I just knew. I asked some people I knew who went to church and they said I was correct. Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? It made me truly believe that there is something out there. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes Within days. Disbelief. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Yes I have heard of it on TV and stuff. I didn't see a light or anything like that. What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real I just knew with no doubts that it was real. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real I still believe it was real even more so now. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No

arrival.other_being_detail: A sensed male being/voice just beyond a door to the right side of her legs; she did not see him but felt and heard him (deep voice, not heard with ears).

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Ruptured tubal (ectopic) pregnancy requiring emergency surgery; she 'crashed' and lost a lot of blood.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Darkness/void-like state; a door/threshold; sensed male presence/voice offering a choice; urgent return with a jerk back into the body; shouted aloud in the operating room.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: She reports loss of body awareness in darkness with peace, then awareness of a door/threshold and a male voice offering a choice, followed by an urgent decision to return and a rapid re-entry into the body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: She perceived a 'door to the right side of my legs' while in darkness, and later staff reported she yelled audibly during surgery: 'No Robert needs me!'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “No! Robert needs me!”; “You are very, very sick and need to go to sleep so I can help you.”
